before.requirement: When streaming mode is enabled and a local XPointer inclusion is encountered, reject it with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED.
before.reason: The rejection is conditional on XPointer support. The explicit harness context does not enable streaming mode; whether the reader supplies an equivalent route and whether the feature is built are unresolved.

after.requirement: When streaming mode is enabled and a local XPointer inclusion is encountered, reject it with XML_XINCLUDE_XPTR_FAILED.
after.reason: The same conditional rejection remains. The explicit context still lacks streaming-mode setup, while the reader route and build defaults remain unresolved.

claims.reason: The same rejection condition appears on both sides, and the old harness's explicit-context setup is the same. Without the reader implementation and feature defaults, it is unknown whether that setup is the same target-wide blocker on both sides.
